summary: Read-only identity/coverage guard for all tracked knowledge materials, including manual/generated code-review evidence; never assigns semantic review status.
contracts: Current tracked/index paths and current worktree bytes; active manifest/pointer/generated-map self references excluded.
SHA equality is identity only. Unknown body/visual/runtime states stay unknown.
side_effects: git ls-files and stdout for guard; test-only temp files/cleanup for fixtures.
errors: Missing/changed/deleted/duplicate/invalid materials or pointer/manifest produce nonzero result.
doc_corrections: Root integrates this guard into knowledge workflow/CI; no source review stamps regenerated by guard.
